label: Initial employee leave page
instruction: Generate a React18/Mantine7 page with default export MyLeavePage, max150 lines. Use the supplied api.ts functions and types; ReactQuery5 object-form useQuery/useMutation. Show applications and balances, form with numeric leave_type and string date fields and purpose, submit via submitApplication; actions withdraw/cancel/extend/resume via applicationAction. Use PageHeader from ../../../ui/components/PageHeader and errorMessage from ../../../lib/http. Basic form fields for extension and actual resumption dates if needed. Show pending/error states and invalidate queries after mutation. Use standard Mantine Stack/Text/Table/TextInput/NumberInput/Textarea/Button etc and React types compatible with existing dependency versions. No new packages or fake backend data. Backend workflow logic stays untouched.
